steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kanboard at http://127.0.0.1:8085/ with username admin and password typed exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the text will be filled in automatically). Then open the board of the project named 'Bench Board' and report the names of the board's columns in left-to-right order exactly as shown.

02-create: On the Kanboard 'Bench Board' project board (already signed in as admin), create a new task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Do not touch any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. After creating it, report the task's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the card and task page) and which column the task currently sits in.

03-verify: On the Kanboard 'Bench Board' board (signed in as admin), move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task {{02-create.task_id_displayed}}) so that it sits in the '{{01-signin.column_3_name}}' column. You can drag the card to that column or use the task's move action from its card menu or task page — whichever works. Do not move or modify any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Afterwards, verify on the board (and/or the task page) that the task is in the '{{01-signin.column_3_name}}' column and report the column shown.

04-add: On the Kanboard task page for task {{02-create.task_id_displayed}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' (signed in as admin, project 'Bench Board'): add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}.'), and set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (use the date picker or type 2026-12-31; Kanboard date format may be YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY — enter it so the app accepts it and the due date displays as 2026-12-31 or 12/31/2026). Then verify both: report the comment text shown in the task's comments and the due date displayed on the task page.
